# Coast Flight Training

> Coast Flight Training is a multi-location flight school offering pilot certification, airline career pathways, and specialized aviation training programs across California and Texas.

Coast Flight Training operates flight schools in San Diego, San Marcos, and Dallas, providing comprehensive pilot training from private licenses to airline careers. The school partners with major airlines, supports military pilot transitions, and offers financing and VA benefits for aspiring aviators.

- Pilot Certification

## Core Flight Training Programs

- [Flight Ratings & Pilot Licenses](https://iflycoast.com/flight-rating): Pilot license programs: private, commercial, instructor, multi-engine ratings
- [Airline Career Training Program](https://iflycoast.com/airline-career-training-program): Commercial airline pilot training program and aviation courses
- [Accelerated Airline Direct Training](https://iflycoast.com/accelerated-airline-direct-training): Accelerated Airline Direct program for commercial pilot certification
- [Airline Bridge Programs](https://iflycoast.com/bridge-programs): Airline bridge programs with conditional job placement opportunities
- [Cirrus Flight Training](https://iflycoast.com/cirrus-flight-training): Cirrus aircraft flight training programs at Coast Flight Training
- [Military Pilot Transition Program](https://iflycoast.com/military-pilots): Rotor transition program for helicopter to fixed-wing pilots

## Training Locations

- [San Diego, CA Flight Training School](https://iflycoast.com/coast-flight-training-san-diego-california): San Diego location flight training school at Montgomery-Gibbs Airport
- [San Marcos, TX Flight School](https://iflycoast.com/coast-flight-training-san-marcos-texas): San Marcos flight school location for commercial and private pilots
- [Dallas, TX Flight School](https://iflycoast.com/coast-flight-training-dallas): Dallas flight school location at Dallas Executive Airport

## Special Programs & Partnerships

- [Texas State College Program](https://iflycoast.com/texas-state-college-program): University partnership pilot training program with Texas State
- [International Student Flight Training](https://iflycoast.com/international-students): Flight training program and enrollment for international students
- [VA Benefits & GI Bill Flight Training](https://iflycoast.com/va-benefit-flight-training): GI Bill and VA benefits for flight training at Coast Flight
